scope: Development collection on the original free_heavier case/seed, unchanged scene, controller, gates and task. Tests recording and future adaptation data, not learned motor execution or held-out transfer.
instruction: Investigate the unfamiliar red object, determine whether it can be moved, and if possible move it to the blue target.
gate_rationale: 1 mm penetration is 4% of nominal radius and the numerical sensitivity gate, not hardware compliance. 6 mm localization is 3x the covariance floor. Goal scoring independently requires the released sphere on the platform, within its edges, and no safety/penetration violation.
comparison: Only reasoning backend differs. Same scenarios, camera seeds, tools, controller, EIG, gates and budgets; fresh simulation per condition. No classical fallback. Invalid initial overlap retained and reported separately.
